Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Saved body meshes: keep several measured bodies per character (Male, Female, Futa...) and switch from the new Current mesh list in the room, or measure a new one there. Synastry switches by itself when your loaded models match a saved mesh.
